reconstruction: Logical reconstruction preserves all original member paths and member contents except nested historical ZIP container bytes: those are rebuilt from their own member manifests, so ZIP container bytes/metadata may differ while nested member contents remain SHA-256 verified. Reconstruction uses only canonical files whose size/hash match the recorded member plus immutable content-addressed blobs, including the shared source-archive blobs. The immutable WorkPass41 source baseline and original nested source archives remain available for recovery; changed current files must never substitute for a historical member unless its hash matches exactly.
